FRESH FULL SUBSYSTEM REVIEW — coverage and authority (part 1).
Exact reviewed head: 5905382334c2865c59c7ab1bb78d79aec5e0c36c, branch eshyra-o9bd.19.4.5.7. Repository clean. Read-only: no repository edits, formatting, full verification, commits, pushes, GitHub comments, or merge. Reviewed owning bead eshyra-o9bd.19.4.5 and every prior review/repair .1 through .6, including the eight S1 members and Nine Lives Stealer S2 from .6. Applied docs/design-and-pr-review-policy.md fresh-subsystem rule after two repairs; docs/importer-fix-protocol.md, rules-pack compiler/ADR 0017, and ADR 0020 source-agreement boundary.

Method: read-only Python listings enumerated ALL 240 magic-item records, every parent mechanics block and all 19 variant mechanics blocks. Read every effect, operation, activation, state/transition, economy/cost/reset/depletion, grant, containment, curse, roll/spell contract and random procedure beside its full printed-description text, including an explicit (item, scope, effect/operation ID or structural path, field, value) listing for operative values. No sampling. Read all 30 distinct mechanics-referenced tables, curated producer/projector helpers and aggregate merge logic in magicItem*.ts, the whole magicItemEffectSourceAgreement.test.ts, and the magic-item-effects registry row. Checked descriptions against the vendored SRD_CC_v5.1.pdf in memory: 3,452 eight-word chunks; after removing page headers, the eight remaining noncontiguous joins are intervening printed tables, not source discrepancies. Direct printed-table/context checks confirmed those joins. General Wearing and Wielding Items, Activating an Item, Command Word, Spells, and Conjure Elemental govern interpretation.

That green result does not close the semantic defect class: the screen checks occurrence/canonical labels and selected representatives, not clause relationships. Findings and structural closure follow in separate appends.

FRESH FULL SUBSYSTEM REVIEW — findings, part 2.
All findings below concern positively emitted mechanics at 5905382334c2865c59c7ab1bb78d79aec5e0c36c. S1–S6 are six blocking ROOT-CAUSE GROUPS, not six individual affected records. Locations are relative to packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/; the full producer filenames are given. Effect/operation IDs name the emitted record; nested paths name blocks without IDs. Each member gives printed authority, emitted disagreement and a distinguishing scenario.

S1 — Applicability is copied into independent effects without preserving the complete printed predicate (target class, actor, weapon/mode, location or prerequisite). Finding authority: the owning bead's source-agreement invariant, the printed descriptions, and correct positively selected capabilities under ADR 0020. A faithful sibling effect or a sourcePhrases substring does not qualify an independently emitted broader effect.

S1.01 Oathbow — c2-residual-oathbow-sworn-enemy-attacks, c2-residual-oathbow-ignore-cover-range, c2-residual-oathbow-sworn-enemy-extra-damage; magicItemResidualCombatEffects.ts:409. Printed: “a ranged attack roll with this weapon against your sworn enemy”; emitted: condition “target is sworn enemy”, triggers “attack targets sworn enemy” / “attack hits sworn enemy”. Both THIS BOW and RANGED are absent. Scenario: an attack with another weapon or a melee blow with the bow receives advantage/cover-range bypass/3d6; printed benefits apply only to the ranged bow attack. Surviving .6 member.

S1.02 Rod of Lordly Might — c2-drain-life-payload and c2-paralyze-payload, corresponding drain-life/paralyze operation activations; magicItemActivatedEffects.ts:1308. Printed: “hit a creature with a melee attack using the rod”; emitted trigger “melee hit with rod”. Scenario: striking an object is offered life-drain healing or paralysis. CREATURE remains missing. Surviving .6 member.

S1.03 Sword of Wounding — c2-residual-apply-wound; magicItemResidualCombatEffects.ts:1177. Printed: once per turn “hit a creature with an attack using this magic weapon”; emitted “weapon attack hits”. Scenario: a hit on an object applies a wound counter. The creature-qualified curse-family operation does not repair this separate residual effect. Surviving .6 member.

S1.04 Vorpal Sword — c2-static-vorpal-no-decapitation-rider; magicItemCombatModifiers.ts:963. Printed: after the creature/head exception, “Such a creature instead takes an extra 6d8 slashing damage”; emitted condition “target cannot be decapitated or is immune to decapitation”, trigger “attack roll 20”. Scenario: a headless object satisfies the emitted fallback and receives the extra damage. Creature scope is absent. Surviving .6 member.

S1.05 Holy Avenger — c2-residual-holy-avenger-aura-saves; magicItemResidualCombatEffects.ts:296. Printed: “You and all creatures friendly to you in the aura”; emitted only “friendly creature in drawn-sword aura”. Scenario: the wielder's own save has no express eligibility although the source separately includes YOU. Preserve self and friendly others as distinct beneficiaries. Surviving .6 member.

S1.06 Decanter of Endless Water — c2-residual-geyser-impact; magicItemResidualCombatEffects.ts:837. Printed: “While holding the decanter”, “a creature you can see within 30 feet of you”; object push “away from you”. Emitted trigger: creature within 30 feet or unworn/uncarried object <=200 lb; result merely “up to 15 feet away”. Scenario: aiming while not holding it, aiming at an unseen creature, or choosing an arbitrary push direction passes the emitted clause. Surviving .6 member.

S1.07 Ring of Shooting Stars — c2-launch-shooting-stars-payload and launch-shooting-stars; magicItemActivatedEffects.ts:629. Printed: motes travel to “a point you can see within 60 feet of you”; emitted “chosen point” plus rangeFeet:60, with no sight predicate. Scenario: an opaque wall does not exclude a point behind it. Surviving .6 member.

S1.08 Bracers of Archery — c2-static-bracers-archery-damage; magicItemCombatModifiers.ts:234. Printed: +2 damage on “ranged attacks made with such weapons”; emitted damageBonus amount:2, appliesTo:“longbows and shortbows”. Scenario: using a bow for an improvised melee attack also qualifies; RANGED has been dropped.

S1.09 Defender — c2-residual-defender-bonus-transfer; magicItemResidualCombatEffects.ts:854. Printed: “first time you attack with the sword on each of your turns”; emitted trigger “wielder makes first attack on turn”. Scenario: attacking first with a different weapon, or first attacking on another creature's turn, permits the transfer. THIS SWORD and YOUR TURN are absent.

S1.10 Ring of Spell Turning — c2-residual-spell-turning-saves; magicItemResidualCombatEffects.ts:550. Printed: a spell targeting only you “(not in an area of effect)”; emitted “spell targets only wearer”. Scenario: an area spell catching just the wearer receives advantage. The separate correctly qualified reflection transform does not supply the missing area exception to the advantage effect.

S1.11 Rod of Alertness — m3-rod-of-alertness-sense-invisible-hostile-location; magicItemPassiveEffects.ts:1250. Printed: beneficiaries in the rod's bright light can sense hostile invisible creatures “also in the bright light”. Emitted: sense with rangeFeet:60 and condition only that the beneficiary stands in the rod's light. Scenario: a beneficiary near the edge senses a hostile beyond the rod's illuminated circle; a hostile at the opposite illuminated edge may instead fall outside the beneficiary's 60-foot range. The area is centered on the rod, and BOTH actors must be in it.

S1.12 Horn of Blasting — c2-blow-horn-payload; magicItemActivatedEffects.ts:1138. Printed: glass/crystal creatures and objects “have disadvantage on the saving throw and take 10d6 thunder damage instead of 5d6”. Emitted special branch glassOrCrystalDamageDice:“10d6”, but no disadvantage on its save. Scenario: a glass creature rolls the same ordinary save as other creatures, contrary to the selected special-case branch.

S1.13 Hammer of Thunderbolts — c2-giant-slaying-critical-payload and giant-slaying-critical; magicItemActivatedEffects.ts:1439. Printed: this is under “Giant's Bane (Requires Attunement)”; emitted natural-20-against-giant death rider has no attunement predicate. Base item requiresAttunement:false is appropriate for the ordinary +1 weapon property, so it cannot gate this rider globally. Scenario: an unattuned wielder using the +1 hammer triggers Giant's Bane. The Strength/hurl branches already preserve their own attunement predicates.

S1.14 Manual of Bodily Health / m2-manual-of-bodily-health-constitution-score-increase (magicItemPassiveEffects.ts:544); Manual of Gainful Exercise / m2-manual-of-gainful-exercise-strength-score-increase (:562); Manual of Quickness of Action / m2-manual-of-quickness-of-action-dexterity-score-increase (:580); Tome of Clear Thought / m2-tome-of-clear-thought-intelligence-score-increase (:687); Tome of Leadership and Influence / m2-tome-of-leadership-and-influence-charisma-score-increase (:705); Tome of Understanding / m2-tome-of-understanding-wisdom-score-increase (:723). Printed, for EACH: increase occurs IF 48 hours studying AND practicing are completed within six days or fewer. EACH emitted abilityScoreIncrease has amount:2 and alsoIncreasesMaximum:true, with no completion condition, trigger or operation binding. The separate study economy's note contains the deadline but is not an applicability condition of these effects. Scenario for each corresponding ability: the effect is applicable before the qualifying study/practice completes. This is a selected conditional reward projected as an unconditional passive increase, not a request to model every book interaction.

S1.15 Wand of the War Mage, +1, +2, or +3 — c2-static-war-mage-rarity-spell-attack; magicItemCombatModifiers.ts:996. Printed: “While holding this wand” gain the spell-attack bonus. Emitted: rarity-based attackRollModifier, appliesTo:“spell attacks”, no holding condition. Scenario: an attuned wand stowed in a pouch still grants the modifier. This is a wand, so the general weapon-wielding rule does not supply holding.

S1.16 Bag of Devouring — containment.overflow; magicItemContainmentInteractions.ts:68. Printed: animal/vegetable matter “placed wholly in the bag” is devoured; a PART of a living creature instead invokes the 50% pull-in rule. Emitted overflow: “animal or vegetable matter is lost forever”, unqualified. Scenario: a hand placed partly inside meets the unconditional matter-loss branch instead of the printed partial-entry distinction.

S1.17 Handy Haversack — containment.rupture.triggers[2]; magicItemContainmentInteractions.ts:183. Printed: overloaded OR “a sharp object pierces it or tears it”; emitted [“overloaded”, “pierced by a sharp object”, “torn”]. Scenario: a tear not caused by a sharp object and not caused by overloading triggers rupture/destruction. The sharp-object qualifier governs tearing as well as piercing.

S1.18 Portable Hole — containment.suffocation; magicItemContainmentInteractions.ts:306. Printed: breathing creature “within a closed portable hole” survives ten minutes then suffocates. Emitted airMinutes:10, dividedByOccupants:false, with no closed-state prerequisite. Scenario: an occupant in an OPEN hole is subjected to the selected suffocation timer. The folding note says what closing does but does not qualify the timer.

FRESH FULL SUBSYSTEM REVIEW — findings, part 3.

S2 — Operations/activation projections omit or invent the printed delivery and eligibility predicates. Reusable operation builders copy a cost or name, while the sourcePhrases checks do not copy the checked requirement. These are disagreements in the already-selected ability/operation, not a demand for whole-item completeness. An operation lacking activation data is not evidence that an arbitrary activation is free: it is an unresolved, unbound projection of a selected use, and cannot be certified as source-agreeing while its printed guard/delivery is dropped.

S2.01 Dagger of Venom — coat-blade.activation.requirement; magicItemActivatedEffects.ts:108 (requirement at :130), merged with magicItemSimpleStateMachines.ts:170. Printed: action to CAUSE poison to coat the blade; emitted “dagger is coated” as a prerequisite to coat-blade. Scenario: the normal initial uncoated dagger cannot be coated. The prerequisite belongs to the later hit payload, not to creating the coating. Surviving eighth S1 member from .6.

S2.02 Animated Shield — speak-command-word / end-animation; magicItemSimpleStateMachines.ts:66, toggle helper :21. Printed: “While holding this shield” speak its word as a bonus action; ending animation requires only a bonus action. Emitted activation omits HOLDING; commandWord:true is copied to BOTH operations. Scenario: animate a shield not held; conversely a silenced wielder cannot end animation although the printed end action needs no word. The weapon/shield wearing rule does not substitute being strapped on for this explicitly printed holding prerequisite.

S2.03 Bowl of Commanding Water Elementals / summon-water-elemental (magicItemUseEconomies.ts:125); Brazier of Commanding Fire Elementals / summon-fire-elemental (:133); Censer of Controlling Air Elementals / summon-air-elemental (:149); Stone of Controlling Earth Elementals / summon-earth-elemental (:250), with shared magicItemEntityGrants.ts:51. Printed respectively: bowl FILLED WITH WATER; FIRE BURNING in brazier; INCENSE BURNING in censer; stone TOUCHING THE GROUND, with the printed action/word delivery for each. Emitted operations only consume a daily use; elementalVessel stores the prerequisite in sourcePhrases, not in the grant or operation applicability. Scenario for EACH: its elemental is selected/summoned with the vessel empty/unlit, or stone off the ground; printed action/command delivery is also unbound.

S2.04 Bead of Force — move-force-sphere; magicItemComplexStateMachines.ts:110. Printed: “A creature enclosed within the sphere” can use its action to push its walls, rolling up to HALF its walking speed. Emitted action operation has no actor/delivery or speed bound. Scenario: an outside actor selects the operation, or an enclosed creature rolls farther than half its walking speed.

S2.05 Broom of Flying — mount-broom, send-broom, recall-broom; magicItemComplexStateMachines.ts:145. Printed: stand astride and speak the word; send to a named location FAMILIAR TO YOU within ONE MILE; recall with another word while still within ONE MILE. Emitted operations have action cost only. Scenario: start without astride/word, send to an unknown distant place, recall from beyond a mile or while unable to speak. Unsupported action costs are separately S3.

S2.06 Carpet of Flying — command-flight and stateMachine active note; magicItemComplexStateMachines.ts:176. Printed: action to speak its command word; thereafter it moves according to spoken directions provided you are WITHIN 30 FEET. Emitted action-only operation and “carpet obeys spoken directions” state drop the word and proximity. Scenario: operate remotely beyond 30 feet.

S2.07 Cloak of the Bat — cast-polymorph; magicItemSimpleStateMachines.ts:155, magicItemUseEconomies.ts:173. Printed: “While wearing the cloak in an area of dim light or darkness” cast polymorph on yourself into a bat. Emitted action/counter and bat-state note have no light predicate. Scenario: transformation in bright light.

S2.08 Dancing Sword — launch-sword / command-attack; magicItemSimpleStateMachines.ts:202. Printed: toss into air AND speak command word; command movement <=30 feet to another spot WITHIN 30 FEET OF YOU, and attack a CREATURE WITHIN 5 FEET OF IT. Emitted bonus-action operations lack delivery, movement bounds and target scope. Scenario: commanding a remote sword or an attack on an object outside its reach. Launch/attack-count lifecycle is separately S4.

S2.09 Decanter of Endless Water — produce-stream / produce-fountain / produce-geyser; magicItemComplexStateMachines.ts:367. Printed: REMOVE THE STOPPER, use action to speak one of three command words. Emitted actions have neither stopper nor word prerequisite. Scenario: a stoppered bottle produces water without speech. Cutoff is separately S4; aiming predicates are S1.

S2.10 Feather Token — use-token with token-kind-payload.variants plus use-anchor/use-bird/use-fan/use-swan-boat/use-tree/use-whip; magicItemConsumables.ts:257 and magicItemComplexStateMachines.ts:442. Printed/emitted disagreements per kind: ANCHOR touch the token to a boat/ship versus action-only activation; BIRD toss five feet into air versus action-only; FAN be ON A BOAT/SHIP and toss up to ten feet into air versus action-only; SWAN BOAT touch a body of WATER >=60 FEET diameter versus action-only; TREE be OUTDOORS and touch UNOCCUPIED GROUND versus action-only; WHIP throw to a POINT WITHIN TEN FEET versus action-only. Scenarios respectively: no vessel contact; no toss; fan on land; boat in a small puddle; tree indoors/occupied space; whip created remotely. Whip's selected attackBonus/damage/movement payload also drops the printed melee spell attack against a CREATURE within TEN FEET OF THE WHIP and repeat-attack command “on your turn”; it has only +9, 1d6+5 force, moveFeet:20 and end conditions. Do not treat “varies by token kind” as the missing kind-specific predicates.

S2.11 Folding Boat — become-boat / become-ship / fold-boat; magicItemComplexStateMachines.ts:490. Printed: action speaking the respective command word. Emitted action-only operations do not require speech. Scenario: expansion by an actor unable to speak. The state termination note mentions the third word, but neither expanding operation is bound to its word.

S2.12 Eversmoking Bottle — close-bottle; magicItemComplexStateMachines.ts:402. Printed: closing REQUIRES speaking its command word as an action. Emitted action-only operation and close transitions do not bind speech as an activation prerequisite. Scenario: closure by a silenced actor. “Stoppered by command” in termination is not an operative guard of the closing transition.

S2.13 Gem of Brightness — shed-light; magicItemSimpleStateMachines.ts:360. Printed all three lighting uses “While holding it”; emitted shed-light action/commandWord has no holding requirement (beam/cone do preserve it). Scenario: activate the stowed gem's light.

S2.14 Gem of Seeing — gain-truesight and m3-gem-of-seeing-truesight; magicItemChargeEconomies.ts:184, magicItemPassiveEffects.ts:944. Printed: ACTION, COMMAND WORD, expend one charge, THEN ten minutes of truesight while peering. Emitted use cost only, and truesight condition only peering through the gem. Scenario: peering before activation/without the word qualifies the selected benefit.

S2.15 Helm of Brilliance — ignite-weapon; magicItemSimpleStateMachines.ts:394. Printed: this property applies “As long as the helm has at least one fire opal”. Emitted action/commandWord has no fire-opal-remaining guard. Scenario: continue igniting weapons after the last fire opal has been expended.

S2.16 Instant Fortress — deploy-fortress / dismiss-fortress; magicItemComplexStateMachines.ts:543. Printed: PLACE CUBE ON GROUND and speak word to deploy; speak word to dismiss (empty prerequisite is preserved in the termination note). Emitted action-only operations lack those delivery requirements. Scenario: deploying in midair or dismissing while silenced.

S2.17 Iron Bands of Binding — throw-bands; magicItemSimpleStateMachines.ts:469. Printed: speak word and throw at HUGE OR SMALLER creature YOU CAN SEE within 60 feet. Emitted action/counter, with restrained effect's range but no command/sight/size guard. Scenario: bind an unseen Gargantuan creature.

S2.18 Pearl of Power — regain-spell-slot; magicItemSpellRollInterop.ts:273. Printed: “While this pearl is on your person” use action/word. Emitted action/word and daily cost preserve delivery but drop ON YOUR PERSON. Scenario: activating the attuned pearl left on a table.

S2.19 Plate Armor of Etherealness — gain-etherealness / c2-residual-ethereal-plane-shift; magicItemUseEconomies.ts:229, magicItemResidualCombatEffects.ts:1080. Printed: wearer speaks COMMAND WORD as an action. Emitted use counter and “wearer uses an action” trigger omit the initial word (ending word is preserved). Scenario: initiating the shift while unable to speak.

S2.20 Ring of Djinni Summoning — summon-djinni / particular-djinni; magicItemUseEconomies.ts:530, magicItemEntityGrants.ts:498. Printed: wear ring, ACTION to speak word, choose an UNOCCUPIED SPACE WITHIN 120 FEET. Emitted cost-only operation/grant lack action/word and placement qualifiers. Scenario: summon without speech or into an occupied/distant space. General worn-ring context does supply wearing; no invented sight condition is required.

S2.21 Ring of Shooting Stars — create-ball-lightning, move-ball-lightning, discharge-ball-lightning; magicItemComplexStateMachines.ts:631. Printed: initial UNOCCUPIED SPACE YOU CAN SEE within 120 feet; move each <=30 feet but no farther than 120 feet FROM YOU; discharge at a CREATURE OTHER THAN YOU within five feet. Emitted action/bonus action only, and free discharge trigger “creature comes within 5 feet”. Scenario: create in unseen occupied space, move without either bound, or discharge merely because the wearer approaches. Shooting-star sight is independently S1.

S2.22 Ring of the Ram — break-object; magicItemChargeEconomies.ts:442. Printed: ACTION, one to three charges, OBJECT YOU CAN SEE within 60 feet, NOT WORN OR CARRIED. Emitted variable-charge operation has no activation/target restriction. Scenario: break a worn/carried object or an unseen object outside 60 feet. This does not claim that variable cost alone permits more charges than the pool contains.

S2.23 Rod of Alertness — cast-detect-evil-and-good, cast-detect-magic, cast-detect-poison-and-disease, cast-see-invisibility; magicItemActivatedEffects.ts:715. Printed: “While holding the rod” use an action. Each emitted operation has action only. Scenario for EACH spell: cast through the attuned rod while it is stowed. Rod is not declared a weapon; general weapon wielding does not supply this explicit prerequisite.

S2.24 Rod of Rulership — command-obedience / c2-residual-rulership-save; magicItemUseEconomies.ts:242, magicItemResidualCombatEffects.ts:1157. Printed: ACTION to PRESENT ROD, chosen creatures YOU CAN SEE WITHIN 120 FEET. Emitted cost-only operation and charm trigger “rod command is issued” do not carry these qualifiers. Scenario: charm a hidden creature 200 feet away without presenting the rod. This is a selected charm/activation, not an unrepresented subsidiary ability.

S2.25 Rod of Security — containment.entry.activation / enter-paradise; magicItemContainmentInteractions.ts:363. Printed: “While holding this rod” action to transport. Emitted entry action has no holding guard. Scenario: transporting while the rod is stowed. Willingness, visibility and maximum accompanying creatures are otherwise preserved.

S2.26 Rope of Climbing — animate-rope; magicItemSimpleStateMachines.ts:609. Printed: HOLD ONE END and ACTION speaking word. Emitted action-only operation. Scenario: animate without holding an end or while silenced. Incorrect moving state and command costs are S3/S4.

S2.27 Rope of Entanglement — release-creature; magicItemSimpleStateMachines.ts:642. Printed: bonus action to speak SECOND COMMAND WORD. Emitted bonus action only. Scenario: release while silenced. The residual effect mentions the release word, but the operation/transition has no binding requiring it.

S2.28 Staff of the Python — become-python; magicItemSimpleStateMachines.ts:715. Printed: action to speak word and THROW STAFF ON GROUND WITHIN TEN FEET. Emitted action-only operation. Scenario: turn a stowed staff or one thrown farther away into the python.

S2.29 Staff of the Woodlands — tree-form; magicItemSimpleStateMachines.ts:751, magicItemChargeEconomies.ts:698. Printed: action, one charge, PLANT ONE END IN FERTILE EARTH. Only RETURNING requires touching tree and speaking word. Emitted tree-form carries commandWord:true copied by toggle from returning, and omits fertile earth. Scenario: cannot plant while silenced although allowed; can transform on barren stone although prohibited. This is another wrong-stage prerequisite like Dagger/Animated Shield.

S2.30 Staff of Thunder and Lightning — lightning / thunder; magicItemChargeEconomies.ts:724. Printed for EACH: “When you hit with a melee attack using the staff”. Emitted daily-cost operations have no hit/melee trigger. Scenario: either selected rider is offered without a melee hit, or on a ranged hit. The correctly represented different Lightning Strike/Thunderclap abilities do not qualify these two operations.

S2.31 Talisman of Pure Good / open-fissure (magicItemChargeEconomies.ts:777); Talisman of Ultimate Evil / open-fissure (:792). Printed for EACH: WEARING OR HOLDING, ACTION, target CREATURE YOU CAN SEE ON THE GROUND WITHIN 120 FEET; alignment qualifier differs. Emitted cost-only operations plus m7 opposition-target effects preserve alignment but omit those other prerequisites. Scenario for each talisman: open the selected fissure under an unseen airborne creature outside 120 feet without holding/wearing the talisman.

S2.32 Wand of Binding — assisted-escape, c2-residual-assisted-escape-save / c2-residual-assisted-escape-check; magicItemChargeEconomies.ts:850, magicItemResidualCombatEffects.ts:643. Printed: “While holding the wand”. Emitted reaction/trigger/cost and advantage effects lack holding. Scenario: receive the assisted escape benefit with the wand stowed. This does not resolve the separate source ambiguity about whether “reaction” grammatically covers the ability-check alternative.

FRESH FULL SUBSYSTEM REVIEW — structural closure, boundaries and disposition (part 6).

Final identifier correction: S2.19's Plate Armor of Etherealness effect ID is c2-residual-etherealness, produced at magicItemResidualCombatEffects.ts:1080; it supersedes the shorthand c2-residual-ethereal-plane-shift. Together with the explicit part-4 corrections, all reported effects/operations/grants now refer to actual emitted IDs or named structural paths.

Recommended STRUCTURAL closure: one owning subsystem repair, followed by a fresh full review of its regenerated exact head. Do not authorize a third list of local field patches as closure. The repeated root is that separately curated families assert different fragments of ONE printed ability without a common applicability/event/cost/lifecycle contract; occurrence checks and same-operation-ID merges cannot prove those fragments compose faithfully.

1. Give each POSITIVELY SELECTED printed ability/clause a source-backed identity and reviewed contract. Capture only the selected responsibility, but its operative predicate must retain actor, wearing/holding/attunement/study qualification, mode/weapon, target class, sight, location/origin, range, delivery, prerequisite/exception, quantity ROLE, timing, and cost-commit condition. Record the supporting printed phrase/table and any inherited general item/spell rule. A staged or partial projection must name its surviving responsibility and the clause/consumer to which it binds; it cannot silently stand in for a complete activation. This is bounded to selected magic-item mechanics, not every printed ability or every SRD record.

2. Derive or explicitly bind effect, operation, transition, economy and grant projections to that SAME contract. Required relations must survive composition rather than be copied into independent free-text strings. In particular, one aura activation ID must own both action and daily charge; the boon from each manual must be bound to qualified study completion; a slain-only charge must commit to the slain outcome; per-figurine identity/count must remain separate; target geometry must name its origin. Detect contradictory applicability or multiple unbound IDs for one selected ability. SourcePhrases.includes and effect-reference resolution remain useful provenance/shape checks, but cannot certify a missing predicate.

3. Remove ungrounded action defaults and shared activation/deactivation requirements. Each stage must carry the printed cost/word/delivery, inherit a named normal spell timing rule where appropriate, or explicitly disclose unresolved source adjudication. Separate cloud existence from bottle openness; summon's existence from control/concentration; damage suppression from ongoing incapacity; component damage from whole-item ownership; counted launch attack from subsequent attacks. Keep exceptions in the applicable branch, not in disconnected descriptive notes. A source-backed control/lifecycle guard must make the exception operative; require an accepted-command event where ignored commands must not cause reversion.

4. Recompile through the curated producers. Do not repair records.json independently or weaken the source expectations to match the current generated pack. Preserve all already established source-backed regression claims from .1–.6; exact reproducers may be consolidated only into demonstrably stronger coverage under docs/importer-fix-protocol.md. These six groups include their surviving members and additional members revealed by the required full scope.

Evidence distinguishing CLOSED from UNCLOSED:
- An identity-based, mechanically enumerated conformance walk covers every current parent AND variant effect/operation/transition/economy/grant carrying these semantics. It must check that each operative projection has the correct source-clause binding and that composition preserves required relations; it must not merely count rows, look for the same words/numbers anywhere in a description, or compare generated data with a baseline copied from that data.
- Independent source authority for each contract comes from the printed text/inherited rule, reviewed independently of the producer. Permanent evidence should protect the durable boundary with proportional contract/composition checks, not hundreds of implementation-mirroring examples. A useful counterfactual set removes/invents one predicate, swaps self/friendly/object/creature or ranged/other weapon, shifts a correct number to the wrong origin/formula role, moves a word/cost to the wrong stage, changes a timer event, and moves a cost/area outcome inside the wrong branch. The mechanism should reject those mutations without a new per-item “known bad” list.
